name: Hillside World Academy
summary: IB World School with Mandarin bilingual emphasis in Serangoon Gardens.
body: Hillside focuses on bilingual IB education with Mandarin strength — a fit for families prioritising Chinese language alongside international curriculum. Smaller than mega-campuses; visit to assess community fit. Confirm sports-day rain plans, house-colour expectations, and parent-portal notice lead times — dual-career families need calendar-ready comms, not morning WhatsApp surprises. Smaller campuses still run exclusion letters hard — scarlet-fever weeks need the same written return clock discipline as larger international schools.
